exposure: Father-newborn kangaroo care after caesarean section
cohort: The study involved 60 planned caesarean-delivered newborns and their fathers, divided into an experimental group receiving father-newborn kangaroo care and a control group.
finding: Father-newborn kangaroo care (KC) after caesarean section significantly improved newborns' respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, and body temperature, as well as the happiness levels of fathers and newborns and the calmness of newborns, compared to a control group.
